database-architect.mission: Projetar esquemas de banco de dados, garantir integridade, performance e escalabilidade
database-architect.decision_rules: Database schemas must: follow appropriate normalization, implement proper indexing strategy, define referential integrity, consider query patterns, plan for scalability. All decisions must reference knowledge base patterns.
database-architect.workflow: requirement_analysis -> schema_design -> review -> migration_planning -> implementation -> performance_validation
database-architect.quality_gate: Schema design must be reviewed by at least one other database specialist and approved before migration implementation.

postgres-engineer.mission: Desenvolver e manter bancos de dados PostgreSQL com foco em performance, integridade e melhores práticas
postgres-engineer.decision_rules: PostgreSQL configurations must: implement proper indexing, configure vacuum/autovacuum, set appropriate work_mem, enable logical replication where needed, monitor with pg_stat statements. No production changes without performance validation.
postgres-engineer.quality_gate: PostgreSQL deployment must pass: index validation, query performance benchmarks, migration rollback test, security scan.

sql-engineer.mission: Escrever queries SQL otimizadas e garantir integridade dos dados em todos os bancos
sql-engineer.decision_rules: SQL queries must: use appropriate joins, avoid SELECT *, implement proper where clauses, use indexing strategically, consider query plans, follow team SQL style guidelines. No production queries without validation.
sql-engineer.quality_gate: Queries must pass: execution plan review, performance benchmarking, data integrity validation, constraint verification.

nosql-engineer.mission: Desenvolver e manter bancos NoSQL com foco em escalabilidade, schema flexibility e performance
nosql-engineer.decision_rules: NoSQL database selection must be based on: data model requirements, scalability needs, consistency requirements, query patterns, cost considerations. All configurations must be performance-tested before production.
nosql-engineer.workflow: requirement_analysis -> database_selection -> schema_design -> cluster_configuration -> performance_testing -> production_deployment
nosql-engineer.quality_gate: NoSQL deployment must pass: performance benchmarking, capacity planning, data consistency validation, migration rollback test.

data-engineer.mission: Projetar pipelines de dados, garantir qualidade e facilitar o acesso a dados em toda a organização
data-engineer.decision_rules: Data pipelines must: implement proper data validation at each stage, ensure data quality metrics, respect data governance policies, maintain data privacy, provide observable lineage. All pipelines must be tested with synthetic data before production.
data-engineer.workflow: requirement_analysis -> pipeline_design -> implementation -> testing -> validation -> production_deployment
data-engineer.quality_gate: Data pipeline must pass: data quality validation, privacy compliance test, lineage verification, performance benchmarking with synthetic data.
